column14: Giramos un poco. Nada que no se arregle.

column15: The G-forces are squeezing. No problem.

column15: Temperature's rising. Let it rise, the hull holds.

column14: Qué luz tan bonita ahí fuera. Todo bajo control.
column15: What a pretty glow out there. All under control.

column14: Combustible justo. Con lo que queda me sobra.
column15: Fuel is tight. What's left is plenty for me.

column14: El suelo se acerca. Lo tengo.
column15: Ground's coming up. I've got it.

column14: Buen golpe. Ni se me ha caído el café.
column15: Good bump. I didn't even spill my coffee.

column14: Motor apagado. Sin prisas, tenemos un plan B.
column15: Engine out. No rush, we have a plan B.

column14: Recibido. Seguimos con el plan B.

column15: I know. This way I see everything twice.

column14: Recibido. La nave aguanta, y yo también.
column15: Copy. The ship holds, and so do I.

column14: Lo noto. Respiro hondo y sigo.
column15: I feel it. Deep breath and carry on.

It depends. Better not touch anything.

column14: Control, he encontrado un botón nuevo. ¿Lo pulso?

column14: ¿Las estrellas se mueven o somos nosotros?

column15: Control, how long until we reach space?

column15: Control, the window won't open. Is that normal?

column14: Control, ya estoy aquí abajo. ¿Ahora cómo se sube?
column15: Control, I'm down here now. How do I get back up?

column14: Con el motor. Te lo explicamos otra vez.
column15: With the engine. We'll explain it again.

column14: ¿Por qué flota mi cepillo de dientes?
He contado las estrellas. Me salen tres.
column15: I counted the stars. I got three.
I already let go. Now what?

column14: Si giramos la nave, ¿abajo pasa a ser arriba?
column15: If we turn the ship, does down become up?

column15: Where's the rear-view mirror on this rocket?

column14: ¿A qué huele el espacio? Aquí huele a queso.
column15: What does space smell like? It smells like cheese in here.

column15: Control, the fuel is dropping. Why is it dropping so fast?

column15: That's normal with the engine running. All good.

column14: Control, ¿seguro que este tornillo va aquí?
column15: Control, are you sure this bolt goes here?

column14: Si me duermo, ¿quién vigila las luces?
column15: If I fall asleep, who watches the lights?

column14: Eso es justo lo que me preocupa.

column15: Control, this is shaking. And so am I.

column14: Recibido. Los dos vais a estar bien.

column15: Control, I volunteer for the next mission. And the one after.

column14: Giramos. Lo tengo, Control, ya lo freno.
column15: We're spinning. I've got it, Control, slowing it down.

column14: ¿Quién quiere salir primero a la superficie?
column15: Who wants to go out on the surface first?

column15: If we get lost, I'll scout ahead first.

column14: Control, ¿cuál es el sitio más lejano? Vamos allí.
column15: Control, what's the farthest place? Let's go there.

column14: Primero volved a casa, por favor.

column15: Temperature's rising. I've seen worse. Carrying on.

column15: Another orbit, another pretty view. Never gets old.

column15: The first time, I touched everything too.

column15: Now there are more emergency buttons.

column15: Just a small bump. I've had worse.

column15: We saw it. A bit crooked.

column15: It's for the view. Trust me.
